symptom.text: After server and control authenticated readiness, the invoker joined with server entity ID 2 but both GET /v1/handshake readiness requests returned authenticated HTTP 409 REQUEST_REJECTED with UNKNOWN outcome and retry_allowed=false.

trigger_conditions.text: The observer freezes boundEntityId and installs StaffPacketTrace synchronously in LoggingIn. The inspected Forge handleLogin disassembly calls firePlayerLogin at bytecode 383 before packet playerId at 387 and LocalPlayer.setId at 401. A provisional ID unequal to the final server ID will violate current() later.

root_cause.text: Implementation lifecycle defect: binding the numeric entity ID and packet witness during LoggingIn can retain the provisional ID before handleLogin assigns the final ID. This code/disassembly finding is distinct from an exact causal reconstruction of the V5 live rejection; the live provisional IDs and exception message were not retained.

repair.text: LoggingIn consumes the epoch and retains the original player, connection lifetime and channel object without freezing the provisional entity ID or exposing a receiver. A one-shot END client tick revalidates those identities and the selected UUID, then binds the final entity ID. Receiver startup verifies and initializes its session and owned directory before a checked callback installs the packet trace; only a successful callback permits receiver activation. Logout, clone, duplicate login, identity loss and startup failure permanently invalidate the pending lifetime, and later entity-ID changes remain rejected.

lesson.text: Defer final numeric identity and packet-witness binding until a verified post-login boundary, retaining the original player/connection checks and fail-closed lifetime semantics. A first client readiness success does not establish correct identity binding for later clients.

causal_chain.text: Control joined with server ID 1 and invoker with ID 2; the provisional client IDs were not captured. Control success is consistent with a coincidental provisional/final match, but does not prove one.

Readiness failure stopped setup before commands or native gestures. Required staff verifiers remain NOT_RUN; intentional exact-owned SIGTERM was followed by closed execution threads and an empty desktop process probe. Original receipts retain FAIL, completed=true, exit_code=1 and timed_out=false.

Exact cached patched archive and class hashes independently confirm the login ordering. Final offline regression and build results are retained separately from live acceptance; post-fix staff behavior remains NOT_RUN.

In the V6 continuation all three authenticated readiness phases succeeded, with the invoker packet witness bound to final entity ID 2. Ten registered setup commands and both released native gestures completed. Separate actual-run review recomputed all four fixed checks as PASS and inspected the three display contexts; the stricter third-person visible-Glowing assertion remains NOT_RUN.
